acceptance_criteria: A documented `CombineHistory` type in `topo.rs`: `target: Vec<Vec<SubShape>>` (for each face of the target, in face index order, its face images in the result) and `tools: Vec<Vec<Vec<SubShape>>>` (for each tool in order, and each of its faces in face index order, its face images in the result). Every image list is sorted by index with no duplicates; a deleted face has an empty list.

A kernel-free helper (no OCCT) that composes one step's face images with the next step's images of the intermediate shape's faces, documented, with unit tests that run without `occt`: a face split in step 1 whose two images are both kept in step 2, one split again and one deleted; an image index out of range of the next step's map is `InvalidInput`.

`Kernel::combine_tracked(&self, op: BooleanOp, target, tools: &[Self::Shape]) -> Result<(Self::Shape, CombineHistory), KernelError>`, documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`: the same solid as `combine` (same volume within 1e-6 relative, same body count and face count), plus its history. Errors are those of `combine`. The inputs are unchanged. No new shim code is expected; any that is added is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions, and every new `unsafe` call is in `ffi` with a SAFETY comment.

Tests (behind `occt`); bounding boxes of image faces (`sub_shape_bounding_box`) within 1e-6 for planar faces and 1e-3 for cylindrical faces: one tool, join, cut, cut that splits; in every case, every image index is below the result's face count, `target` has one entry per target face and `tools[i]` one per face of tool `i`.
Errors, each with a test and never a panic: no tools, or a face (from `make_face`) as target or tool, is `InvalidInput`; an intersect with no common volume is `EmptyResult`.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M3-10b: Tracked combine: combine_tracked with face history for the target and every tool
